setting.title: If you check this box, you will be able to register payments using Canadian CPA005 (EFT and PAD).
setting.help: This will enable both Vendor Payments and Customer Payments using Canadian CPA005 EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) and PAD (Pre-Authorized Debit).
